Salesforce capture on 2026-11-25 in a Developer Edition scratch org.
Salesforce CLI 2.159.7. The scratch org was deleted after capture.
Only synthetic metadata and records were used.

At each API, set both Apex class and trigger metadata versions and the
project source API version to the captured version. Deploy with
sf project deploy start --api-version VERSION. Assign ZephyrTextAccess
with sf org assign permset before running the probes.

Anonymous: sf apex run --api-version VERSION --file ../anonymous.apex.
The log transports one OBS| JSON object. The DML statement and Database
method run in the deployed probe class at the captured version.

@IsTest: sf apex run test --api-version VERSION --tests ZephyrTextProbeTest
--synchronous --result-format json. The single intentional assertion
failure transports the same OBS| JSON object.

The 62.0 and 67.0 observations matched on both routes. Plain Text in
Trigger.new has leading and trailing space and tab removed. A Text value
containing only those characters reads null.
The caller retains its assigned values. An assignment inside the before
trigger remains padded in that trigger and is trimmed for after insert
and SOQL.

NEIGHBOR PROBES
Account Name and Site exercise standard fields via Database.insert.
Uncaptured neighbors retain main behavior: update and upsert, before-save
Flow input, specialized text field types, non-space/tab trim characters,
and trigger-only writes before a later before trigger runs.
